The '''Nar Shaddaa Works Administration''' (NSWA) was an organization that operated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In that time, [[Gord Madel]] worked at the office in the [[Duros Sector]] not far from [[Meridian Hall]] and was known to take bribes. The [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], during their search to defeat [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Paladius]], decided to create the illusion of a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] by having Madel detonate the pipes underneath the Meridian Complex in a demonstration of power to Palladius's followers.
